title: Hold a licence to provide non-emergency patient transport
what: Provide non-emergency patient transport services (transport of patients whose medical needs have been assessed as requiring it) only under an NEPT licence from the Secretary, unless part of the Ambulance Service.

sources.title: Ambulance Service Act 1982 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not provide non-emergency patient transport services unless the person – (a) holds an NEPT licence; or (b) is providing the service as part of the Ambulance Service

administration.who: Secretary of the Department administering the Ambulance Service Act 1982 (Tas)

sources.title: Ambulance Service Act 1982 (Tas)
sources.locator: s 35B, words naming the body (found 20 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: The Secretary must not grant a licence to provide non-emergency patient transport services unless satisfied that – (a) if the applicant is a natural person, the applicant is a fit and proper person;
